stem: Which electronic health record (EHR) documentation practice by the nurse best supports safe client care?

options.A: Enter client-care documentation accurately, completely, and in a timely manner
options.B: Delay all charting until the end of the shift and reconstruct details from memory
options.C: Copy a prior assessment forward without verifying that the findings are still current
options.D: Omit unexpected findings from the record until the nurse can determine whether they are clinically important

rationale: The 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan identifies accurate, complete, and timely computer documentation as an Information Technology activity within Management of Care. Therefore A is the best answer. Delayed reconstruction, unverified copy-forward, and omission of assessment findings undermine documentation accuracy and completeness.
educational_objective: Use the EHR to document nursing care accurately, completely, and in a timely manner.

audit_findings: A directly matches the NCSBN activity statement. B risks inaccurate delayed reconstruction; C fails to verify current client data; D makes the record incomplete. One best answer remains with direct NCLEX relevance and no unsupported external claims.
